questions.prompt: Solve for x and check your result: 9x - 13 = 3x + 21
hints: Move all the x terms to one side of the equation and all the constant terms to the other side.
Combine like terms, then divide both sides by the coefficient of x to isolate it.

misconception.commonWrongAnswer: Forgetting to flip the sign of a term when it is transposed across the equals sign.
misconception.why: Treating transposition as copying a term to the other side rather than as a sign-flipping move — the shorthand for subtracting/adding that term on both sides.
misconception.remediationHint: When a term crosses the equals sign, its sign flips: a term that was positive becomes negative, and vice versa.
